# Varadanam

> Varadanam is a complete temple management software for Hindu temples in Kerala and South India. It enables online vazhipadu and seva booking, counter billing, devotee management, donation tracking, financial reports, and a branded temple website — all in one platform.

## What Varadanam does

Varadanam helps temple trustees and administrators digitise their temple operations:

- **Online vazhipadu booking** — Devotees can browse, book, and pay for vazhipadu and sevas online from any device, including from abroad (NRI devotees)
- **Counter billing (POS)** — Temple priests and staff can record walk-in bookings and cash payments at the counter
- **Devotee management** — Store devotee names, nakshatras, gothrams, and booking history
- **Donation tracking** — Record and receipt all temple donations
- **Financial reports** — Daily, monthly, and annual reports suitable for Devaswom Board audits
- **Branded temple website** — Each temple gets its own website where devotees can book online

## Who uses Varadanam

- Temple trustees and managing committees
- Devaswom Boards (Travancore, Cochin, Malabar)
- Temple administrators and priests
- NRI devotees booking vazhipadu from abroad
